title: Pure Hand
summary: Girag's Barian Hand control build, pairing the self-floating Fire Hand and Ice Hand loop with Thunder Hand, Prominence Hand, and the Seventh Rank-Up engine. Every Main Deck Hand either floats on destruction or shares the 1600 original ATK or DEF statline that triggers Thunder Hand.

summary.title: Starters
points: Seventh Ascension adds Seventh Tachyon or Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force, and Seventh Tachyon reveals Number 106: Giant Hand in the Extra Deck to search a Level 4 monster.
Fire Hand (1600 ATK) and Ice Hand (1600 DEF) recruit each other from the Deck while popping monsters and Spells/Traps whenever destroyed by the opponent.
Prominence Hand Special Summons itself from the hand while you control Magic Hand, Fire Hand, or Ice Hand for an immediate Rank 4 Xyz Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Hand + Prominence Hand + Seventh Ascension
steps: Normal Summon Fire Hand, Ice Hand, or Magic Hand, then Special Summon Prominence Hand from the hand.
Overlay both Level 4 monsters into Number 106: Giant Hand for Quick Effect monster negation.
Use Seventh Ascension to search Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force, ready to upgrade Number 106 into Number C106: Giant Red Hand.

summary.title: The 1600 Statline & Destruction Loop
summary.text: When Fire Hand is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to the GY, it destroys an opponent's monster and Special Summons Ice Hand from the Deck; when Ice Hand is destroyed, it pops a Spell or Trap and summons Fire Hand. Because Fire Hand (1600 ATK), Ice Hand (1600 DEF), and Magic Hand (1600 DEF) all have 1600 original ATK or DEF, any destruction of those monsters by battle or card effect—including your own Torrential Tribute—triggers Thunder Hand from the hand or GY to Special Summon itself and destroy a card on the opponent's field.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Number 106: Giant Hand detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect when an opponent's monster effect activates on the field to negate that monster's effects and lock its battle position.
Number C106: Giant Red Hand detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect when any card or effect activates on the field to negate all other face-up cards on the field until the end of the turn.
Magic Hand punishes the opponent whenever they add a card from their Deck to their hand outside of drawing by sending that card to the GY and inflicting 800 damage.
Tornado Dragon, Castel, Time Thief Redoer, Number 101: Silent Honor ARK, and Number 41: Bagooska round out the Rank 4 toolbox.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Supply Squad draws 1 card once per turn whenever a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, turning every Fire Hand crash or Torrential Tribute into card advantage.
Torrential Tribute wipes all monsters on summon and destroys your 1600 ATK/DEF Hand monster to immediately trigger Thunder Hand from the hand or GY.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force ranks up Number 106: Giant Hand into Number C106: Giant Red Hand and steals an opponent's Xyz Material.

main: Fire Hand

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1600 ATK / 1000 DEF): when destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to the GY, destroys 1 monster they control and Special Summons Ice Hand from your Deck; its 1600 original ATK satisfies Thunder Hand!
Ice Hand

Level 4 WATER Aqua (1400 ATK / 1600 DEF): when destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to the GY, destroys 1 Spell/Trap they control and Special Summons Fire Hand from your Deck; its 1600 original DEF satisfies Thunder Hand!
Thunder Hand

Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1600 ATK / 1600 DEF): Quick Effect when a face-up monster(s) you control with 1600 original ATK or DEF is destroyed by battle or card effect: Special Summons itself from hand OR GY and destroys 1 card your opponent controls!
Prominence Hand

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (600 ATK / 2000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a 'Magic Hand', 'Fire Hand', or 'Ice Hand', providing an instant Rank 4 Xyz Summon into Number 106: Giant Hand.
Magic Hand

Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (800 ATK / 1600 DEF): when your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand (except by drawing), immediately sends that card(s) to the GY and inflicts 800 burn damage; has 1600 DEF for Thunder Hand!
